text.p: Matav-Cable Systems Media Ltd (An Israeli Corporation)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers; U.S. dollars)
NOTE: Net and revenue data for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 1995 were not provided in U.S. dollars.
Revenue for the fourth quarter in adjusted New Israeli Shekels (NIS) 78.3 million (U.S. $24.1 million), compared with NIS 69.3 million, an increase of 13.1 percent from the same period a year ago.
Net income for the fourth quarter 1996 reached NIS 16.2 million (U.S. $5.0 million), compared with NIS 7.9 million, an increase of 106.4 percent over last year.
Net income per ADS for the fourth quarter was NIS 1.20 (U.S.$0.37) versus NIS 0.73 (U.S. $0.22), last year.
Revenue for the full year ended December 31, 1996 reached NIS 300.4 million (U.S. $92.4 million), compared with NIS 266.7 million, an increase of 12.6 percent over the same period a year ago.
Net income for the year was NIS 46 million (U.S. $14.2 million), compared with NIS 21.9 million, up 110.4 percent from the same period last year.
Net income for the year per ADS was NIS 3.74 (U.S. $1.15) in 1996 versus NIS 2.02 (U.S.$0.62), last year.
